JSON round-trip tests must verify that amounts are serialized as strings (e.g., `"1234.56"`) and that feeding JSON numbers back through `serde::str` fails, ensuring the string contract is maintained. This prevents precision loss and enforces the ADR-007 standard.

learned.title: Lantern JSON serialization for Decimal
learned.knowledge: To prevent precision loss in JSON clients, `rust_decimal::Decimal` fields must be serialized as strings using `#[serde(with = "rust_decimal::serde::str")]`. The `arbitrary_precision` feature should not be used as it still results in `f64` parsing on the client side. This convention is cross-referenced to ADR-007.
